newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 4,079.8 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 4,079.8 mln Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said sight deposits rose by 300.3 million Swiss francs to 4,079.8 million in the reporting period ended June 20.
A spokesman for the SNB, in response to an enquiry, said that the latest data showed that the SNB was continuing its flexible, generous policy.
"Nothing special," he said with respect to the rise in sight deposits in the latest period.
"This reaffirms our flexible stance in the money market," a spokesman said.
Statement of June 23 in millions of Swiss francs:
Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window rose by 100,000 Swiss francs to 100,000 from nil.
Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 30.5 million to 2,537.4 million. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
